firefly:
Explicit-entry router: enters only when named; subcommands are the mandate boundary.
Adds a skill registry with health check (trigger words, description drift) and a one-line
mode declaration on enter/exit.
firefly-think:
Reads files before asking; every round is <=5 decidable questions with candidate
answers; stops when remaining questions cannot fork the design. Output is a requirements
memo where every requirement has a pass/fail predicate.
firefly-draw:
Non-trivial decisions require >=2 competing options, each with its own kill
conditions; the most expensive assumption is validated first via prototype or retrieval.
The user arbitrates; the agent only recommends.
firefly-propose:
Three layers: long-lived constitution, short-lived delta spec, task list. Every
requirement maps to a Given/When/Then scenario whose language drops straight into test
files; a spec without acceptance criteria cannot proceed to tasks.
firefly-bounds:
Constraints live as an executable checklist (perf budget, memory cap, compat matrix,
security red lines), each bound to a runnable check; when no number exists, ratchet on the
measured baseline. A diff-weakening checklist (new suppressions, skipped tests, stripped
assertions, lowered thresholds) is enforced by firefly-guard. Security execution and CI
mounting belong to firefly-guard; bounds defines, guard enforces.
firefly-tasks:
One task one verification; explicit blocked-by edges that drive dispatch; task briefs carry
enough pointers for a context-free executor (never the spec pasted in); checkboxes only move
on verification evidence.
firefly-implement:
Green steps; frontier dispatch from the blocked-by graph (parallel where possible, per-ticket
worktree + merge responsibility); pointer-only communication (spec section, task file, paths,
acceptance command); stop and go back to think/propose when spec does not cover a fork;
minimal change.
firefly-source:
Three-level source priority: local source (behavior truth) > official docs (contract truth) >
community (leads only). Every behavioral claim carries file:line, symbol or official URL.
Six-part output: known facts / reasonable inferences / competing hypotheses / unknowns /
sources / confidence — empty results recorded.
firefly-doubt:
Run by an independent fresh-context subagent (self-assessment is void). Kill list (top 5
ways this could be wrong), each tied to a runnable check; counter-example tests for the top
two, with output; verdict: survives / survives wounded / dead. Written to changes/<id>/doubt.md.
firefly-context:
Anthropic's four levers operationalized: minimal sufficiency at task start,
NOTES.md persistence across compaction, a five-field handoff standard, and context
hygiene. Recovery after compaction must not re-ask answered questions.
firefly-ui:
Component gate (semantics, keyboard, focus, contrast, ARIA), explicit UI state
machines with illegal states unrepresentable, dual-track a11y: automated scan plus a
manual keyboard walkthrough. No component passes on scan alone.
firefly-arch:
Public interfaces ship their contract (signature, errors, versioning,
compat) into the spec before implementation; architecture choices become ADRs; modules
talk only through explicit contracts; big refactors climb runnable steps.
firefly-tdd:
Baseline green before touching code; every new test's first failure output is
archived as red evidence; tests are locked — changing a test is a spec change, never a
drive-by edit during implementation.
firefly-verify-web:
Browser proof runs in a throwaway profile (the default profile carries logged-in
sessions and is never handed over). A verdict requires the evidence triple: action
sequence, screenshot/recording, and DOM/network assertions, all archived.
firefly-review:
An independent reviewer agent sees only the declared input list (diff, spec, task brief,
red/green evidence from tdd, doubt report, security report). Parallel dimensions:
correctness, simplification, risk, tests, security, counter-evidence, standard-consistency.
Findings are adjudicated must-fix / suggest / accept (own design). Modes: light, regular,
--deep (module-wide simplification sweep) and spec (scenario completeness, testability,
constitution conflicts, re-runs one killing test).
firefly-guard:
Runnable security checklist (parameterized queries, input validation, least
privilege, no secrets at rest); secrets arrive by injection; dependency changes get
standalone supply-chain review; irreversible actions stop on a reversibility test, not
an enumerated list. CI gates: red means no merge.
firefly-pr:
The PR's first reader is its reviewer: single topic, size threshold with split
guidance, a description covering why/what/how-verified/risks with evidence links. Ready
means the review report is zeroed out.
firefly-docs:
Spec drift is reported; irreversible choices force a four-part ADR (context,
options, decision, consequences); docs are written for retrieval (title-as-query,
self-contained sections); docs contradicting code are fixed or deleted on the spot.
firefly-trace:
Every task emits a five-field run record under changes/<id>/trace.md, written by the skill
and consumed by archive and retro; OTel GenAI conventions are used only as field-naming
reference, never as a compliance target. Instrumentation guidance is question-driven
(2-4 on-call questions first) with cardinality control.
firefly-archive:
Definition-of-done as an evidence checklist (tests green, gate green, review zeroed, spec
synced, docs updated, temp artifacts cleaned); archive appends the run record. Carries
deprecation: inventory with migration paths, expand-contract, a down path per migration,
one consumer per migration, advisory by default. Publish control plane (flags, staged
rollout, error budget) is explicitly out of scope.
firefly-retro:
Transcript digest (prompts/corrections, tool calls and results, files touched — no verdicts),
three parallel lenses (judgment / tooling / divergent), three-bucket adjudication
(accepted / rejected / backlog), and structure-first routing: anything a lint rule, script or
gate can enforce goes to backlog instead of prose.
